PHW theme for reactable

Source: R/html-widgets.R
phw_reactable_theme.Rd

A reactable::reactableTheme() that uses the PHW font and colours: a navy header rule, light grey striping and hover, and the yellow keyboard focus outline used on phw.nhs.wales.

Usage

phw_reactable_theme(
  font_size = 14,
  header = c("booktabs", "navy", "light"),
  accent = phw_colours[["navy"]],
  ...
)

Arguments

font_size

Base font size in px.

header

Header style: "booktabs" (navy text and rules), "navy" (navy band, white text) or "light" (light teal band).

accent

Colour used for the header, rules and current page button.

...

Other reactable::reactableTheme() arguments. They override the PHW defaults.

Value

A reactable theme.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("reactable", quietly = TRUE)) {
  tbl <- reactable::reactable(head(mtcars),
                              theme = phw_reactable_theme(header = "navy"))
  if (interactive()) print(tbl)
}
